title: Validation Service — Implementer Adoption
description: Who uses the Validation Service, which IFC schemas and functional parts (alignment!) their tools actually produce, and which MVDs they declare. Built for the Implementers Assembly.

list.name: company
list.label: Company
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM ifc_company ORDER BY name
list.description: Filter the content panels to one implementer; 'All' = everyone. Stat tiles stay global.

list.name: bucket
list.label: Granularity
list.description: Time bucket for the trend panels. Distinct counts are per bucket: 'active at least once in that quarter/month'. The running (incomplete) bucket is excluded.

list.name: uploader
list.label: Uploader
list.query: all : all, vendor staff : vendor, other : other
list.description: Filter the header-quality panels by uploader. 'vendor staff' = users whose email address matches a known vendor company's domain pattern (the is_vendor flag, set automatically at login and via an admin action) - effectively people at the tool makers. 'other' includes hand-made and scripted files.

panels.title: Companies
panels.description: How many companies use the service? Derived from the authoring tool named in the file header; 'in range' = at least one upload in the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT at.company_id) FROM ifc_model m
        JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created)) AS "in range",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ifc_company) AS "all-time"

panels.title: Tools
panels.description: How many distinct authoring tools upload here? Counted by name stem: canonical_name (language package stripped, IVS-884) cut at the first digit, so all versions of 'Revit' count once.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name), '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)')) FROM ifc_model m
        JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created)) AS "in range",
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name), '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)')) FROM ifc_authoring_tool at) AS "all-time"

panels.title: Tool versions
panels.description: How many distinct tool versions do we see? A version is name + version as written in the header; language packages of the same version count once (canonical_name, IVS-884).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (COALESCE(NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name), at.version)) FROM ifc_model m
        JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created)) AS "in range",
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT (COALESCE(NULLIF(canonical_name, ''), name), version)) FROM ifc_authoring_tool) AS "all-time"

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ifc_model m WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created)) AS "in range",
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ifc_model) AS "all-time"

panels.title: Schema adoption
panels.description: Is IFC 4.3 taking over from IFC4 and IFC2X3? Uploads per month by schema family; Respects the Company filter. Bucketed by $bucket; the running (incomplete) bucket is excluded. The tiny 'other' family and headerless '(empty)' uploads are hidden for legibility.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH s AS (SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', m.created) + (CASE WHEN '$bucket'='quarter' THEN interval '3 months' ELSE interval '1 month' END)/2 AS time, upper(replace(replace(COALESCE(m.schema, ''), ' ', ''), '_', '')) AS raw
           FROM ifc_model m LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created) AND m.created < date_trunc('$bucket', now()) AND ('$company' = 'All' OR at.company_id::text = '$company'))
SELECT time, CASE WHEN raw ~ 'IFC4X3|IFC4\.3' THEN 'IFC4X3' WHEN raw ~ 'IFC4X[12]' THEN 'IFC4X1/4X2' WHEN raw ~ '^IFC4' THEN 'IFC4' WHEN raw ~ 'IFC2X3|^2X3' THEN 'IFC2X3' WHEN raw = '' THEN '(empty)' ELSE 'other' END AS metric, COUNT(*)::float AS value
FROM s GROUP BY 1, 2 
) q WHERE metric NOT IN ('other','(empty)') ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Who produces IFC 4.3: distinct tools and companies
panels.description: How many tools and companies actually ship IFC 4.3 files each month? Respects the Company filter. Bucketed by $bucket; the running (incomplete) bucket is excluded.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (date_trunc('$bucket', m.created) + (CASE WHEN '$bucket'='quarter' THEN interval '3 months' ELSE interval '1 month' END) - interval '1 hour') AS time, 'tools' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name), '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)'))::float AS value
FROM ifc_model m JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created) AND m.created < date_trunc('$bucket', now()) AND upper(replace(replace(COALESCE(m.schema, ''), ' ', ''), '_', '')) ~ 'IFC4X3|IFC4\.3' AND ('$company' = 'All' OR at.company_id::text = '$company') GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT (date_trunc('$bucket', m.created) + (CASE WHEN '$bucket'='quarter' THEN interval '3 months' ELSE interval '1 month' END) - interval '1 hour') AS time, 'companies' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT at.company_id)::float AS value
FROM ifc_model m JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created) AND m.created < date_trunc('$bucket', now()) AND upper(replace(replace(COALESCE(m.schema, ''), ' ', ''), '_', '')) ~ 'IFC4X3|IFC4\.3' AND ('$company' = 'All' OR at.company_id::text = '$company') GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Capability: functional parts produced, by distinct tools and companies
panels.description: Which parts of IFC do tools really produce, and by how many tools and companies? A part counts when one of its rules activated (any result other than N/A). Lower bound; refreshed nightly. Respects the Company filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT functional_part AS part, CASE functional_part WHEN 'PJS' THEN 'Project definition' WHEN 'GRF' THEN 'Georeferencing' WHEN 'BLT' THEN 'Built elements' WHEN 'ASM' THEN 'Assemblies' WHEN 'SPA' THEN 'Spaces' WHEN 'VRT' THEN 'Virtual elements' WHEN 'GEM' THEN 'Geometry representation' WHEN 'OJP' THEN 'Object placement' WHEN 'POS' THEN 'Positioning elements' WHEN 'OJT' THEN 'Object typing' WHEN 'GRP' THEN 'Groups' WHEN 'SPS' THEN 'Spatial breakdown' WHEN 'MAT' THEN 'Materials' WHEN 'PSE' THEN 'Properties' WHEN 'QTY' THEN 'Quantities' WHEN 'CLS' THEN 'Classification' WHEN 'ANN' THEN 'Annotations' WHEN 'LAY' THEN 'Presentation layers' WHEN 'CTX' THEN 'Colours & textures' WHEN 'POR' THEN 'Ports' WHEN 'STR' THEN 'Structural' WHEN 'CST' THEN 'Costing' WHEN 'SDL' THEN 'Scheduling' WHEN 'LIB' THEN 'Library references' WHEN 'DOC' THEN 'Documentation references' WHEN 'CTR' THEN 'Constraints' WHEN 'VER' THEN 'Versioning' WHEN 'AXG' THEN 'Axis geometry' WHEN 'ALS' THEN 'Alignment geometry' WHEN 'ALA' THEN 'Alignment' WHEN 'ALB' THEN 'Alignment' WHEN 'PBG' THEN 'Point-based geometry' WHEN 'TAS' THEN 'Tessellated meshes' WHEN 'BRP' THEN 'BREP geometry' WHEN 'CSG' THEN 'CSG geometry' WHEN 'SWE' THEN 'Swept geometry' WHEN 'TFM' THEN 'Transformations' WHEN 'BBX' THEN 'Bounding box' WHEN 'IFC' THEN 'Schema & file structure' WHEN 'LOP' THEN 'Local placement' WHEN 'MPD' THEN 'Mapped geometry' WHEN 'LIP' THEN 'Linear placement' WHEN 'RFT' THEN 'Referents' ELSE functional_part END AS "functional part",
       COUNT(DISTINCT tool_stem)  AS tools,
       COUNT(DISTINCT company_id) AS companies,
       SUM(models)                AS "volume (model-months)"
FROM vs_adoption_capability
WHERE $__timeFilter(month) AND ('$company' = 'All' OR company_id::text = '$company')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC, 4 DESC

panels.title: Alignment (ALA/ALB/ALS): distinct tools and companies
panels.description: How many tools and companies produce alignment each month? Respects the Company filter. Bucketed by $bucket; the running (incomplete) bucket is excluded.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (date_trunc('$bucket', month) + (CASE WHEN '$bucket'='quarter' THEN interval '3 months' ELSE interval '1 month' END) - interval '1 hour')::timestamptz AS time, 'tools' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT tool_stem)::float AS value
FROM vs_adoption_capability WHERE functional_part LIKE 'AL_' AND $__timeFilter(month) AND month < date_trunc('$bucket', now()) AND ('$company' = 'All' OR company_id::text = '$company') GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT (date_trunc('$bucket', month) + (CASE WHEN '$bucket'='quarter' THEN interval '3 months' ELSE interval '1 month' END) - interval '1 hour')::timestamptz AS time, 'companies' AS metric, COUNT(DISTINCT company_id)::float AS value
FROM vs_adoption_capability WHERE functional_part LIKE 'AL_' AND $__timeFilter(month) AND month < date_trunc('$bucket', now()) AND ('$company' = 'All' OR company_id::text = '$company') GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: MVD declared per tool (top 20)
panels.description: Which Model View Definitions do tools declare - and who declares Alignment-basedView? Respects the Company filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name), '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)') AS tool, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.mvd, ''), '(none)') AS mvd, COUNT(*) AS models
FROM ifc_model m JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created) AND ('$company' = 'All' OR at.company_id::text = '$company')
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Capability, last 2 months - LIVE (slow, ~15 s; ignores time picker)
panels.description: Same question as the capability table, computed live for the last 2 months. Works before the nightly job has ever run; slow.

targets.rawSql:
WITH w AS (SELECT min(id) AS tid FROM ifc_validation_task WHERE created >= now() - interval '2 months')
SELECT left(vo.feature, 3)          AS "functional part",
       COUNT(DISTINCT m.id)         AS models,
       COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name), '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)'))       AS tools,
       COUNT(DISTINCT at.company_id) AS companies
FROM ifc_validation_outcome vo
JOIN ifc_validation_task    vt ON vt.id = vo.validation_task_id
JOIN ifc_validation_request vr ON vr.id = vt.request_id
JOIN ifc_model              m  ON m.id  = vr.model_id
LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
WHERE vo.validation_task_id >= (SELECT tid FROM w)
  AND vo.severity > 0 AND vo.feature ~ '^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]{3}'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC, 4 DESC

panels.title: Alignment capability, cumulative
panels.description: Tools and companies that have EVER demonstrated alignment (an activated ALA/ALB rule) - capability once shown stays shown. Live on the outcomes table, ~15 s; ignores the time picker; running bucket excluded. Respects the Company filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH acts AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', vo.created) AS b, COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name), '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)') AS tool_stem, at.company_id
  FROM ifc_validation_outcome vo
  JOIN ifc_validation_task vt ON vt.id = vo.validation_task_id
  JOIN ifc_validation_request vr ON vr.id = vt.request_id
  JOIN ifc_model m ON m.id = vr.model_id
  LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
  WHERE vo.feature >= 'ALA' AND vo.feature < 'ALC' AND vo.severity > 0 AND ('$company' = 'All' OR at.company_id::text = '$company')),
buckets AS (SELECT DISTINCT b FROM acts WHERE b IS NOT NULL AND b >= '2024-01-01' AND b < date_trunc('$bucket', now())),
ft AS (SELECT tool_stem, min(b) AS fb FROM acts GROUP BY 1),
fc AS (SELECT company_id, min(b) AS fb FROM acts WHERE company_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1)
SELECT b + (CASE WHEN '$bucket'='quarter' THEN interval '3 months' ELSE interval '1 month' END) AS time, 'tools (cumulative)' AS metric,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ft WHERE ft.fb <= buckets.b)::float AS value FROM buckets
UNION ALL
SELECT b + (CASE WHEN '$bucket'='quarter' THEN interval '3 months' ELSE interval '1 month' END), 'companies (cumulative)', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fc WHERE fc.fb <= buckets.b)::float FROM buckets
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Header quality: which FILE_NAME fields fail
panels.description: Which of the four FILE_NAME fields that determine header validity (and thus vendor attribution) fail, as share of models with a stored header. originating_system, company_name and application_name derive from one string and fail together in 99% of cases - one exporter fix clears all three. Other header fields (description, author, time_stamp, ...) are recorded but do not affect validity. Respects the Company and Uploader filters.

targets.rawSql:
WITH src AS (
  SELECT m.header_validation AS hv FROM ifc_model m
  LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created) AND jsonb_typeof(m.header_validation->'validation_errors')='array' AND ('$uploader' = 'all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ifc_validation_request vr LEFT JOIN ifc_user_additional_info uai ON uai.user_id = vr.created_by_id WHERE vr.model_id = m.id AND CASE WHEN '$uploader' = 'vendor' THEN COALESCE(uai.is_vendor, FALSE) ELSE NOT COALESCE(uai.is_vendor, FALSE) END)) AND ('$company' = 'All' OR at.company_id::text = '$company'))
SELECT e AS field, ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*)/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM src),1) AS "% of models"
FROM src, jsonb_array_elements_text(hv->'validation_errors') e
WHERE e IN ('originating_system','company_name','application_name','version') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Clean headers over time
panels.description: Share of uploads whose FILE_NAME header passes the IFC 101 policy with zero field errors. Bucketed by $bucket; the running (incomplete) bucket is excluded. Respects the Company filter. Respects the Uploader filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', m.created) + (CASE WHEN '$bucket'='quarter' THEN interval '3 months' ELSE interval '1 month' END) AS time, 'clean headers' AS metric,
       ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_array_length(m.header_validation->'validation_errors')=0)
             /NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.header_validation IS NOT NULL),0))::float AS value
FROM ifc_model m LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created) AND m.created < date_trunc('$bucket', now()) AND ('$uploader' = 'all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ifc_validation_request vr LEFT JOIN ifc_user_additional_info uai ON uai.user_id = vr.created_by_id WHERE vr.model_id = m.id AND CASE WHEN '$uploader' = 'vendor' THEN COALESCE(uai.is_vendor, FALSE) ELSE NOT COALESCE(uai.is_vendor, FALSE) END)) AND ('$company' = 'All' OR at.company_id::text = '$company')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: IFC 4.3 capability, cumulative
panels.description: Tools and companies that have EVER uploaded an IFC 4.3 file - capability once shown stays shown. Ignores the time picker; running bucket excluded. Respects the Company filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH acts AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', m.created) AS b, COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name), '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)') AS tool_stem, at.company_id
  FROM ifc_model m JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
  WHERE upper(replace(COALESCE(m.schema,''),' ','')) ~ 'IFC4X3|IFC4\.3' AND ('$company' = 'All' OR at.company_id::text = '$company')),
buckets AS (SELECT DISTINCT b FROM acts WHERE b IS NOT NULL AND b >= '2023-01-01' AND b < date_trunc('$bucket', now())),
ft AS (SELECT tool_stem, min(b) AS fb FROM acts GROUP BY 1),
fc AS (SELECT company_id, min(b) AS fb FROM acts WHERE company_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1)
SELECT b + (CASE WHEN '$bucket'='quarter' THEN interval '3 months' ELSE interval '1 month' END) AS time, 'tools (cumulative)' AS metric, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ft WHERE ft.fb <= buckets.b)::float AS value FROM buckets
UNION ALL
SELECT b + (CASE WHEN '$bucket'='quarter' THEN interval '3 months' ELSE interval '1 month' END), 'companies (cumulative)', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fc WHERE fc.fb <= buckets.b)::float FROM buckets
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Models per declared MVD
panels.description: How much each Model View Definition is used, among ATTRIBUTED uploads only (a parsed tool in the header) - so tools/companies counts are real. '(none)' = attributed vendors without a declared MVD: only ~3% - vendors almost always declare one. Unattributed uploads are excluded. Respects the Company filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(m.mvd,''),'(none)') AS mvd, COUNT(*) AS models,
       COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name), '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)')) AS tools, COUNT(DISTINCT at.company_id) AS companies
FROM ifc_model m JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created) AND ('$company' = 'All' OR at.company_id::text = '$company')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Export toolkit landscape
panels.description: Which IFC export libraries sit behind the market's tools, from the header's preprocessor_version (stored for 91% of uploads since 2025 - including files whose vendor identity failed to parse). One toolkit bug reaches every vendor built on it. Toolkit = leading name, version stripped.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(m.header_validation->>'preprocessor_version', '\s*[-0-9v(][0-9.].*$', ''), ''), '(empty)') AS toolkit,
       COUNT(*) AS models, COUNT(DISTINCT m.produced_by_id) AS tool_versions
FROM ifc_model m
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created) AND m.header_validation IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12

panels.title: Alignment-basedView: declared vs demonstrated
panels.description: Tools declaring Alignment-basedView in the header, and whether we ever saw an alignment rule activate on their files in the window. 'not observed' means no alignment content passed through validation - not proof the tool cannot do it. Attributed uploads only. Respects the Company filter.

targets.rawSql:
WITH decl AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(at.canonical_name, ''), at.name), '\s*[0-9][0-9.]*.*$', ''), ''), '(unknown)') AS tool, COUNT(*) AS models
  FROM ifc_model m JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created) AND m.mvd ILIKE '%alignment%' AND ('$company' = 'All' OR at.company_id::text = '$company')
  GROUP BY 1),
act AS (SELECT DISTINCT tool_stem FROM vs_adoption_capability WHERE functional_part LIKE 'AL_' AND $__timeFilter(month))
SELECT d.tool, d.models AS "models declaring ABV",
       CASE WHEN d.tool IN (SELECT tool_stem FROM act) THEN 'yes' ELSE 'not observed' END AS "alignment demonstrated"
FROM decl d ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Header gaps over time: vendor identity and MVD
panels.description: The two practical header gaps, as share of uploads with a stored header (since Jan 2025). 'no vendor identity' = the originating_system cluster failed (company/application/version derive from that one string and fail together in 99% of cases). 'no MVD derivable' = no ViewDefinition could be extracted at all. Deliberately NOT shown: the strict description-policy failure rate (~55%) - 75-84% of those files still yield a usable MVD, so that line measures formatting strictness, not practice. Running bucket excluded. Respects the Company and Uploader filters.

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('$bucket', m.created) + (CASE WHEN '$bucket'='quarter' THEN interval '3 months' ELSE interval '1 month' END) AS t,
         (m.header_validation->'validation_errors' ? 'originating_system') AS os_err,
         (COALESCE(m.mvd,'') = '') AS mvd_missing
  FROM ifc_model m
  LEFT JOIN ifc_authoring_tool at ON at.id = m.produced_by_id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(m.created) AND m.header_validation IS NOT NULL AND m.created < date_trunc('$bucket', now())
    AND ('$company' = 'All' OR at.company_id::text = '$company') AND ('$uploader' = 'all' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ifc_validation_request vr LEFT JOIN ifc_user_additional_info uai ON uai.user_id = vr.created_by_id WHERE vr.model_id = m.id AND CASE WHEN '$uploader' = 'vendor' THEN COALESCE(uai.is_vendor, FALSE) ELSE NOT COALESCE(uai.is_vendor, FALSE) END)))
SELECT t AS time, 'no vendor identity (originating_system cluster)' AS metric,
       ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE os_err)/COUNT(*))::float AS value FROM base GROUP BY 1
UNION ALL
SELECT t, 'no MVD derivable', ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mvd_missing)/COUNT(*))::float FROM base GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Tools per functional part
panels.description: Presentation view of the capability table: how many distinct tools demonstrably produced each functional part in the window (a rule of that part activated). Same source and caveats as the table above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE functional_part WHEN 'PJS' THEN 'Project definition' WHEN 'GRF' THEN 'Georeferencing' WHEN 'BLT' THEN 'Built elements' WHEN 'ASM' THEN 'Assemblies' WHEN 'SPA' THEN 'Spaces' WHEN 'VRT' THEN 'Virtual elements' WHEN 'GEM' THEN 'Geometry representation' WHEN 'OJP' THEN 'Object placement' WHEN 'POS' THEN 'Positioning elements' WHEN 'OJT' THEN 'Object typing' WHEN 'GRP' THEN 'Groups' WHEN 'SPS' THEN 'Spatial breakdown' WHEN 'MAT' THEN 'Materials' WHEN 'PSE' THEN 'Properties' WHEN 'QTY' THEN 'Quantities' WHEN 'CLS' THEN 'Classification' WHEN 'ANN' THEN 'Annotations' WHEN 'LAY' THEN 'Presentation layers' WHEN 'CTX' THEN 'Colours & textures' WHEN 'POR' THEN 'Ports' WHEN 'STR' THEN 'Structural' WHEN 'CST' THEN 'Costing' WHEN 'SDL' THEN 'Scheduling' WHEN 'LIB' THEN 'Library references' WHEN 'DOC' THEN 'Documentation references' WHEN 'CTR' THEN 'Constraints' WHEN 'VER' THEN 'Versioning' WHEN 'AXG' THEN 'Axis geometry' WHEN 'ALS' THEN 'Alignment geometry' WHEN 'ALA' THEN 'Alignment' WHEN 'ALB' THEN 'Alignment' WHEN 'PBG' THEN 'Point-based geometry' WHEN 'TAS' THEN 'Tessellated meshes' WHEN 'BRP' THEN 'BREP geometry' WHEN 'CSG' THEN 'CSG geometry' WHEN 'SWE' THEN 'Swept geometry' WHEN 'TFM' THEN 'Transformations' WHEN 'BBX' THEN 'Bounding box' WHEN 'IFC' THEN 'Schema & file structure' WHEN 'LOP' THEN 'Local placement' WHEN 'MPD' THEN 'Mapped geometry' WHEN 'LIP' THEN 'Linear placement' WHEN 'RFT' THEN 'Referents' ELSE functional_part END || ' (' || functional_part || ')' AS "functional part",
       COUNT(DISTINCT tool_stem) AS tools
FROM vs_adoption_capability
WHERE $__timeFilter(month) AND ('$company' = 'All' OR company_id::text = '$company')
GROUP BY functional_part ORDER BY 2 DESC
